title: Limit on Open Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contracts per Customer
content:
**Credit Policy — Concentration of balloon contracts.** A customer may hold at most 2 open Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contracts at the same time.

## What counts as open

A balloon contract counts as open in every status except paid in full, closed and charged off. A contract still pending funding counts as open.

| Contract status | Counts toward the limit of 2 |
|---|---|
| Pending funding | Yes |
| Active, assigned for repossession, repossessed, deficiency, returned | Yes |
| Paid in full, closed, charged off | No |

## Effect

A booking that would exceed the limit is declined at funding review and is never booked. Contracts the customer holds in other Kestrel products, such as a retail contract, a pre-owned contract or a lease, do not count toward this limit.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A customer holds one active balloon contract and one balloon contract pending funding. A third balloon booking would make 3 open contracts and is declined at funding review.
- A customer holds one active balloon contract and one balloon contract that is paid in full. Only one counts as open, so a second open balloon contract may be booked.
- A customer holds one active balloon contract and two Kestrel leases. The leases do not count, so a second balloon contract stays within the limit.
